notes: SURPRISE: verify is semantically read-only but uses POST, and cookie-authenticated POSTs go through the CSRF gate -- so a cookie-only verify without Content-Type: application/json is 403, not 200. The frontend always sends both CSRF requirements (src/services/api.js sends Content-Type on every request and X-Requested-With on every mutation-method request), so it never sees this.
With Content-Type: application/json but missing X-Requested-With the body is {"error": "Missing required request header"} instead (checks run in that order).
